Container.Name: magscan
Container.Overview: Reads magazine covers (PDF/CBZ/EPUB) with an AI vision model, renames the files to your template and writes Booklore-compatible .metadata.json sidecars and embedded PDF metadata. Review everything in the web UI before applying.

Config.Name: Magazine library
Config.Description: Folder with your magazines. Use the same folder Booklore's library points to.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: From console.anthropic.com. Leave empty when using Ollama.

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: claude-opus-5-5 is most accurate; claude-haiku-5-5 is far cheaper for big collections

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: A vision model pulled into Ollama

Config.Name: File name template
Config.Description: Initial value; can be changed later in the web UI

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Optional: move renamed files here instead of renaming in place (map a path for it too)

Config.Name: Auto-scan minutes
Config.Description: Scan for new files and read their covers every N minutes (0 = manual)
